title: Governing-Scope Recorded Held-Capacity Commitment Read

classification.name: low-level-single-stream-governing-scope-reader
classification.rationale: FOOD-007J establishes the repository pattern of a low-level D1 reader for one SKU or slot selector and FOOD-007K separately composes multiple reads. FOOD-007Q preserves that separation for cumulative governing-scope reads. A later reservation-level composition unit will consume FOOD-007P and call FOOD-007Q in canonical order.

purpose: Read durable held reservation quantity recorded for one exact SKU stream or one exact fulfillment-slot stream cumulatively through a supplied governing capacity-source revision.

relationshipToFood007P.scopeRule: same exact stream and capacityRevision <= governingRevision
relationshipToFood007P.boundary: FOOD-007Q does not itself derive or validate the entire FOOD-007P reservation scope. It accepts one already-chosen exact stream boundary per call.

relationshipToFood007J.food007qSemantics: same exact stream cumulatively through governing revision
relationshipToFood007J.keySqlDifference: FOOD-007J uses capacity_revision = ?; FOOD-007Q uses capacity_revision <= ?

sku.id: bounded nonempty reference string under the same validation convention as FOOD-007J

slot.locationReference: bounded nonempty reference string under the same validation convention as FOOD-007J
slot.windowReference: bounded nonempty reference string under the same validation convention as FOOD-007J

shape: INNER JOIN food_capacity_reservations AS reservation ON reservation.reservation_id = line.reservation_id
INNER JOIN food_capacity_reservations AS reservation ON reservation.reservation_id = slot.reservation_id
slot.aggregatePolicy: SUM(quantity), not COUNT(*), preserving the same recorded-held quantity vocabulary and SQL convention as FOOD-007J even though migration 0003 currently constrains durable slot quantity to 1.

sku.recordedHeldQuantity: cumulative stored held quantity for the same exact SKU stream where capacity_revision <= governingRevision

slot.recordedHeldQuantity: cumulative stored held quantity for the same exact slot stream where capacity_revision <= governingRevision

invalidBoundary: Malformed, non-exact, unsupported, accessor-bearing, symbol-bearing, sparse, non-data, or otherwise invalid selector input must return invalid without issuing a database read, following FOOD-007J hostile-input capture conventions.
storageFailureBoundary: Database prepare/bind/all failures and malformed aggregate response envelopes or quantities return storage-failure. Storage-failure does not become invalid.

semanticExamples.case: rev1 held 3, rev2 held 4, rev3 governs
rev1 held 3, rev2 governs, rev3 held 4

concurrency: The result is a read-time aggregate under the injected database/session semantics only. Later inserts may occur immediately after the read. FOOD-007Q does not establish a mutation-time authoritative snapshot.
lifecycleBoundary: Migration 0003 currently supports durable held rows only. FOOD-007Q does not infer future release, expiration, cancellation, replacement, consumption, or rescheduling semantics.
nonClaims: current active commitments after future lifecycle support
migration0003Execution: not authorized and not required for FOOD-007Q source implementation
nextDependencyIntent: A later reservation-level resolver should accept/re-derive FOOD-007P scope, call FOOD-007Q once per SKU scope in canonical command order plus once for slot scope, and return a detached frozen bundle without performing capacity arithmetic or admission.
